reasons.plausibility: Combining DSC, CALPHAD, and in-situ neutron imaging to measure melting and thermodynamic properties in HEAs is scientifically sound and aligns well with established methods, though database and short-range ordering uncertainties introduce some minor concerns.
reasons.testability: It includes a clear set of experimental and modeling steps, with a specific criterion (±20% error) for falsification that can be directly measured.
reasons.usefulness: This integrated approach offers a valuable, systematic method to accurately determine complex phase-transition properties for various high-entropy alloys.
